//: Not the web app's config any more. That one moved to apps/web/tsconfig.json along with the app, taking the DOM libs, the JSX and the `@/*` alias with it. What is left here is the root's own tooling — vitest.config.ts and anything that lands beside it — so `include` is deliberately flat: `*.ts`, not `**/*.ts`. Nothing under apps/, packages/, services/ or tools/ is reachable from this file.
//workspaces: Every workspace carries its own tsconfig, and `npm run typecheck` runs this one and then all of them through `--workspaces --if-present`. A new workspace needs a tsconfig and a typecheck script, or it is not checked at all.
//tools: There is no `exclude` for tools/manimkc, tools/remotionkc, tools/revideokc or tools/tldrawkc. There used to be one for the tldrawkc submodule, because the root config's `**/*.ts` walked into it and typechecked a repo we do not own against the wrong compiler options. A flat `include` cannot reach it, so the exclude would now be defending against nothing. eslint.config.mjs still ignores all four, because ESLint does walk the whole tree from here.
